evaluations.rationale: Selected initial plan. It localizes the defect to the policy comparison and has a clear bounded experiment, but it must be extended to cover named entities and later numeric termination.
Selected. The most direct continuation: full entity decoding only for the policy view, with explicit allowed and relative controls. It preserves the serializer contract and is immediately testable.
Deferred. A useful parser-level alternative and a strong compatibility falsifier, but a larger blast radius than the policy-local repair.
Deferred. Coherent strict allowlist fallback; risks changing custom-protocol and exotic relative semantics.
Retained as an unexecuted alternative. The nested-encoding claim is testable but likely confused about single-pass browser resolution; it was not selected.
Deferred. Useful byte-for-byte regression gate and determinism control, but not a competing causal repair.
